turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting resistance welding electrode diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the initial electrode inspection. Check the electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than one millimeter or mushrooming, examine the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage, and inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Initial inspection complete. The electrode caps show minor surface wear but no deep pitting or mushrooming. Shank surfaces are clean and the coolant ports are clear.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do you observe electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming, or cracking?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the caps are in serviceable condition with only minor wear.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode face diameter within the wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the face diameter is within the acceptable range for continued operation.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both electrodes are showing adequate flow rates above the minimum specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode force within plus or minus five percent of the programmed schedule value?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured force is well within tolerance of the programmed value.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the measured weld current within plus or minus three percent of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the weld current is tracking within the acceptable tolerance band.

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the weld time within plus or minus one cycle of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the timing is accurate and within one cycle of the schedule.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the electrode faces parallel with a contact pattern above ninety percent of the face area?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the carbon transfer pattern shows concentric contact covering more than ninety percent of the face area.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the pilot weld appearance show no spatter, expulsion, or surface cracks?

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all pilot welds look clean with no spatter, expulsion, or visible cracks.

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the weld nugget diameter meet the minimum for material thickness?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the ultrasonic scan shows the nugget diameter exceeds the minimum requirement.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the peel test show button pull failure mode with no interfacial fracture?

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing interfacial fracture on several samples instead of full button pull.

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please revise the weld schedule by increasing the heat input incrementally.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've adjusted the schedule and increased the heat input. Ready to reverify.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the peel test result after the schedule revision.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The peel test is still showing interfacial fracture. The issue persists even after adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: This procedure is complete. The peel test failure is persistent and requires escalation. Please notify the metallurgical review team for further analysis.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: peel test failure persistent, metallurgical review

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood. I'll escalate to the metallurgical team immediately.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: peel test failure persistent, metallurgical review
